FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF JAMMU & KASHMIR AND LADAKH
(Office of Registrar General at Srinagar)
Advertisement Notice No. 02 of 2022/RG/NG
Dated: 25-05-2022
Subject: - Advertisement for posts in different categories (Non-Gaetted), in the High Court
of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
a) Date of commencement for submission of online applications: 30-05-2022
h) Last date for submission of online applications: 18-06-2022
c) Last date for submission of fee: -06-2022
Total number of posts advertised = ( 05)
Online applications are invited from eligible candidates for participating in the
selection process for various posts shown against Item code No. mentioned in the
"Annexure-A" to this notification who:
i) are domiciles of UT of Jammu and Kashmir in terms of S.O 166 dated 18.05.2020
issued by GAD, Government of Jammu and Kashmir and those who are resident of
UT of Ladakh for a period of not less than 15 years before the date of applying and
is actually residing in the area.
ii) are having age as on 0101.2022.
i) Not below 18 years, and
ii) Not above;
(a)40 years in case of Open Merit.
(b)43 years in case of SC/ST/RBA/ALC/OSC
(c) 42 years in case of Physically Challenged candidates.
(d)48 years in case of Ex. Servicemen.
(e)40 years in case of candidates in Government Service/Contractual
employees;
iii) are in possession of the prescribed minimum academic! professional! technical
qualifications and fulfil all other eligibility conditions wherever enquired as
shown against each post/item in the Annexure "A" by or before the last date
of submission of application forms i.e,. 18-06-2022.
iv) have deposited fees of Rs. 360/- (Rupees Three hundred and sixty only).
v) applications alongwith the prescribed fee shall he received only through online
mode on the Recruitment Portal of the High Court of i&K, link of which shall be
active on 30-05-2022 on the website of the High Court:
http//jkhighcou rt.nic.in.
vi) before applying online, candidates are advised to carefully go through the
guidelines for online submission of applications. These guidelines will be
available in the online portal of the High Court of Jamnu and Kashmir.
Note:
a) Candidates who are eligible to apply for more than one post are required to apply
separately for each post.
b) The number of vacancies may increase or decrease, depending on their availability
at the time of selection.
c) The reservation for various categories would be determined as per the provision
of S.O 127 dated 20.04.2020.
d) Submission of Application Form and fee payment shall not be
accepted/entertained after the cut-off date fixed for receipt of the same.
e) Candidates shall not submit the printout of the Application Form /fee payment
receipt to the office of Registrar General, High Court of i&K at this stage.
1) Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. In
no other mode, the Application Form would be accepted and even online
incomplete Application Form would not be accepted.
g) The printout of the application alongwith the fee payment receipt and required
copies of documents shall be kept ready to be submitted as and when required.
h) rhe in-service candidates / contractual employees shall submit photocopy of the
filled up online application form through proper channel viz, the concerned Head
of Department. In the event of failure of the candidate to route the application
through proper channel, his /her eligibility shall be assessed as if he/she is not an
in-service candidate. The Head of Department concerned shall forward the
application form of the in-service candidates at the adthess of the Registrar
General, High Court of J&K within 20 days after the last date of filing their
Application Form.
I) The last date for the submission of online application forms as prescribed above
shall be the cut-off date for determining the eligibility to apply for the post. The
age limit, however, is determinable with reference to the 1st of January, 2022. Any
qualification/experience acquired after last date of receipt/submission of online
application form i.e., 18-06-2022 shall not be taken into account for any purpose.
j) The prescribed qualifications reflect the bare minimum requirement of the job
and mere possession thereof shall not entitle a candidate to be called for written
test/interview.
k) The Criteria formulated for selection to the posts advertised will he uploaded on
the official Website of the High Court http//jkhighcourt.nic.in.
I) Call letters shall not be issued individually however, wide publicity shall be given
through print and electronic media, official Website http//jkhighcourt.nic.in of the
High Court about the venues, dates of the written test/interview for the
information of eligible candidates. No claim of being unaware of the
dates/schedule for written test/interview shall be entertaine1.
m) No TA/DA will he paid for participation in the written test/interview.
Byorder. )
